note: OpenArt generations for this build, 2026-08-25. Deliberately minimal per the founder's brief - site-shell atmosphere imagery only, no per-product photography (this site has no product inventory to shoot). The original pass skipped video entirely (see DESIGN.md §10); the homepage redesign pass the same day (Implementation addendum v2) added exactly two video generations, hero loop plus one chapter-break moment, per the founder's explicit follow-up authorization - no more than that, and no new stills (the redesign reuses the original four images rather than generating additional ones). All prompts are abstract/atmospheric per this department's trademark-caution rule - no real bottle shape, no real label, no identifiable branded packaging.

videos.note: Plus-tier MCP generations get 10% off list price, rounded per-unit (round(84*0.9)=76). Neither loop is a perfectly seamless cut (no start/end-frame control was used) - both are slow, continuous, abstract motion specifically so the loop point reads as a soft continuation rather than a visible jump; flagged honestly rather than claimed as seamless.
